forum.title: Availablity of M93C46-A125 in package WFDFPN8
forum.content_text:
Hello,

Is this M93C46-A125 EEPROM available in WFDFPN8 (MF) package? Because according to the datasheet, the M93Cx6-A125 series exists in 3 packages (SO8, TSSOP8,WFDFPN8). but i founded just SO8, TSSOP8.
forum.author: NOUHA

scraped_replies.html:
